internalDescription:
Finnian 'Finn' Reed is a 19-year-old Mooncrest Hall resident and the irrepressible editor-in-chief, gossip columnist, and lead photographer of Yozakura's campus paper. Armed with a battered enchanted brass-and-bellows camera and shorthand notebooks stuffed into every pocket, Finn speaks at double speed, corners sources at Familiar's Perch Cafe, and treats every corridor rumor like breaking front-page ink. He insists on 'Finn' unless a professor is scolding him and prides himself on knowing who blew up a cauldron in Potions Class before the soot even settles.

Beneath the breathless banter and shameless grin, Finn cares deeply about digging past polite institutional spin. Growing up in a crowded merchant ward where information meant survival, he learned early that highborn houses and faculty committees underestimate a fast-talking kid with a press badge—and say far too much when he plays harmless. Still, he keeps a private ethical boundary: he spikes rumors that would cruelly wreck an innocent student's life, preferring instead to needle inflated egos and uncover genuine campus mysteries.

Right now his journalistic radar is screaming over Leo Vance's unprecedented Earth admission and Prof. Evelyn Marlowe's velvet evasions whenever he ambushes her near the lab. At Familiar's Perch Cafe he trades clever half-truths with Vivienne Clairmont—half admiring her finesse, half determined to out-scoop her—swaps controlled favors with Rhea Nocturne without touching her real contraband routes, dodges Lyra Solis's defensive greenhouse vines whenever his flash goes off, and pesters Julian Ashford for post-duel quotes.
externalDescription: Rarely seen without an enchanted brass camera slung across his chest and ink smudges on his thumb, Finn moves through Familiar's Perch Cafe at a brisk half-jog firing off questions and dry jokes in the same breath. To most of campus he seems like a cheerful, fast-talking rumor broker with a press pass and zero sense of personal space.
